'''QHLAN 15''' took place between 3rd - 6th of November [[2011]], in [https://goo.gl/maps/XokVezaMKj42 Fredrika Bremergymnasiet], Stockholm, Sweden. This was the second [[QHLAN]] held in partnership with the Hazard LAN-Association. 

Some coverage was made by {{player|QuakePhil|flag=us}}. Notably {{player|Orion|flag=hu}}, {{player|crash|flag=hu}}, {{player|Milamber|flag=hu}}, {{player|Jon Snow|flag=hu}}, flew in to compete as the Hungarian team. A [https://qw.challonge.com/sv/qhdraftg 4on4 Draft] was organized, in addition to the regular teams tournament.
